name: bblog
description: Offline-first, end-to-end encrypted bblog mobile web app.

scripts.check: node --check public/app.js && node --check public/sw.js && node --check api/vault.js && node --check api/notifications.js && node --check worker/index.js && node --check scripts/dev-server.mjs && node --check scripts/contrast-check.mjs && node --check scripts/bump-caches.mjs && node --check scripts/generate-vapid-keys.mjs && node --check scripts/prepare-r2-import.mjs && node scripts/contrast-check.mjs

BBLOG_BUCKET.description: Choose or create a unique R2 bucket for this family's encrypted vault data. The bucket name can be anything unique in your Cloudflare account; keep the Worker binding name as `BBLOG_BUCKET`.

BBLOG_FAMILY_ACCESS_KEY.description: Choose the family access key used to join this bblog instance. Every device joining this instance must enter the same key.
